name: @examples/rn-brownfield
description: React Native brownfield example: react-native/ is packaged as an AAR and an XCFramework that the native android/ and ios/ host apps embed.

scripts.demo:android: pnpm --filter @examples/rn-brownfield-react-native publish-local:aar && pnpm --filter @examples/rn-brownfield-android build && pnpm --filter @examples/rn-brownfield-android android
scripts.demo:ios: pnpm --filter @examples/rn-brownfield-react-native package:ios && pnpm --filter @examples/rn-brownfield-ios frameworks && pnpm --filter @examples/rn-brownfield-ios ios
